## Current Affiliations

- Senior Associate Dean for Academic Programs [UCLA Fielding School of Public Health](https://ph.ucla.edu).
- Professor, [UCLA Department of Biostatistics](https://ph.ucla.edu/departments/biostatistics).
- Professor, [UCLA Department of Statistics & Data Science](https://statistics.ucla.edu).
- Affiliate Professor, [UCLA Institute of the Environment & Sustainability](http://www.ioes.ucla.edu).

## Educational History

- B.S. (Honours) Presidency College, Calcutta, India, 1994.
- M.STAT. Indian Statistical Institute, Calcutta, India, 1996.
- Ph.D. Statistics, University of Connecticut, Storrs, Connecticut, USA, 2000.

## Research Interests

- Spatial statistics and Geographic Information Systems.
- Bayesian inference and machine learning methods.
- Scalable Gaussian process models for BIG DATA analysis.
- Statistical computing and related software development.
